headline: Brazil's RD Saúde Reports 9.2% Growth in Q3 Net Profit to R$439 Million
summary: Pharmacy retailer RD Saúde posted an adjusted net profit of R$439.1 million in Q3, up 9.2% year-over-year, driven by revenue expansion and reduced financial expenses.
why: RD Saúde (RaiaDrogasil) is Brazil's largest drugstore operator by sales and store footprint, making its earnings a primary measure of Brazilian healthcare retail health.
